Scene #2: Morning (08:05:00) in The Great Library—the golden sunlight of Hammer filters through the high, arched windows, illuminating millions of dust motes that dance above the endless rows of oak shelves. Aric (Lvl 1), a scholar whose calloused hands speak of combat training just as much as his ink-stained fingers speak of study, sits at a heavy mahogany desk cluttered with half-rolled parchments. The air is thick with the scent of aged vellum, cedarwood, and the faint, ozone-tang of residual magic from the Restricted Section.

A few aisles over, Elin (Lvl 2), a young scribe with ink on her nose, is shelving a stack of heavy codices. She pauses, glancing toward your desk with a hesitant smile. Further down the hall, the rhythmic 'clack-clack' of a cane announces the presence of Master Thorne (Lvl 12), the Head Archivist, as he makes his rounds, his white robes sweeping the stone floor. 

"Master Aric (Lvl 1)," Elin (Lvl 2) whispers as she approaches, leaning in close. "I heard some of the older scholars talking. They say the basement levels aren't as empty as the maps suggest... that something has been moving the ledgers in the night."

You have come here seeking knowledge that others have forgotten, or perhaps hidden. The library is vast, and the day is young.
Main Character: I pause to take stock of what I just learned and the power now within reach.

Scene #3: Morning (08:05:00) in The Great Library—you pause, the ink drying on your quill as Elin's (Lvl 2) whispered rumor sinks in. You take a slow, deep breath, feeling a sudden sharpening of your senses and a steadying of your pulse. The rigorous combat drills you've maintained alongside your studies seem to coalesce into a new reservoir of martial potential. You feel capable of pushing your body beyond its normal limits—a burst of speed and power you've only glimpsed in training. 

Elin (Lvl 2) lingers for a moment, her eyes darting toward the heavy iron-bound doors of the basement stairs. Master Thorne (Lvl 12) has already vanished into the stacks toward the Restricted Section, his rhythmic cane-clacks echoing faintly through the hall. The library, once a sanctuary of quiet study, suddenly feels like a labyrinth of secrets waiting to be unraveled. You have the knowledge of the rumors, the observation of the Archivist, and a newfound strength within you.
